title: A Mixed-Precision Model for Matrix-Splitting Methods
summary: The performance of stationary iterative methods is memory-bound, due to the low arithmetic intensity. So, we propose a mixed-precision technique to reduce the amount of data movement in matrix-splitting iterative methods. We demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that this technique will generally converge at a similar rate as an exact-precision iteration, depending on the precision used and the conditioning of the $M$ matrix.
